capabilities: Render family trees, org charts and timelines from person notes
Edit frontmatter fields inline from the tree view
Upload or link avatar photos for persons
Create and link person notes from cards or the file explorer
Browse persons in a sortable, searchable table
extras: Works fully offline with no telemetry; card positions are stored in a plugin data file, not in notes; known issues list documents mobile touch-control gaps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize and edit people-related data (family trees, org charts, timelines) stored in note frontmatter.
summary: Interactive family tree, org chart and timeline viewer built from Markdown notes with type: person YAML frontmatter.
